card.title: Retroactive Permission
card.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How do you feel about me inviting a few people to dinner?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So standing guests would be more considerate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six. I've already invited them. Would borrowing enough chairs for everyone turn that into a yes?

mechanism: A negotiates approval of already-issued dinner invitations by solving the practical objection.
confusable: Unlike ordinary event planning, A must reveal the act precedes the yes being sought.
comparison: D04-b admits six invited guests and bargains over chairs; D04-a keeps a garden-removal fait accompli under a hypothetical question.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
